accepted.evidence: Turner 5994 lists Khetrani trē under tráyaḥ and Lahnda trāe under the same article’s *trāyaḥ subdivision. Grierson Khetrani trāē agrees with the latter local vowel shape; the broad article is secure, but its precise inherited subdivision is not asserted. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.
Turner 12278 directly lists Khetrani sau “100” under śatá. Grierson gives exactly sau “Hundred”. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.

Turner 13574 directly lists Lahnda-Khetrani suj “sun” under sū́ra, specifically the sū́rya subdivision. Grierson gives exactly suj “Sun”. Exact digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.
